answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the opal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ember re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The lagoon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
